captions.summary: [finite_null_rank] Exchangeable pooled rank p = (1+b)/(N+1) over N = 39 nulls scored identically to the observation (Phipson-Smyth exact-discrete); support {1/40, ..., 1}, resolution floor 1/40 (never 0). Super-uniform under exchangeability; the max scan preserves within-row dependence; no significance finer than the resolution is reported. Matched-null-conditioned global calibration only; no detection.
